top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a falsifiable prediction (Z2 invariant with helical edge channels) and a decisive experiment that could have failed (HgTe edge conductance), reproduced independently for about two decades across several material families. The allocation of Kane, Mele and Molenkamp is the least disputed on the shortlist, and a narrow citation limited to the time-reversal-invariant topological insulator and quantum spin Hall effect, with HgTe named, keeps the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and 3D work as context. P002 (optical lattice clocks) is mature and well attributed, but its novelty over the 2005 and 2012 prizes and the Katori/Ye priority remain open, so it ranks second, above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no listed collaboration with Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye, and my astroparticle work (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, XL-Calibur) is outside both fields
